entries.title: Psalms 44:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. An instruction.>> O God, with our ears have we heard, our fathers have told us, the work thou wroughtest in their days, in the days of old:

entries.title: Psalms 44:2
segments: Thou, by thy hand, didst dispossess the nations, but them thou didst plant; thou didst afflict the peoples, but them didst thou cause to spread out.

entries.title: Psalms 44:3
segments: For not by their own sword did they take possession of the land, neither did their own arm save them; but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst delight in them.

entries.title: Psalms 44:4
segments: Thou thyself art my king, O God: command deliverance for Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 44:5
segments: Through thee will we push down our adversaries; through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:6
segments: For I will not put confidence in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

entries.title: Psalms 44:7
segments: For thou hast saved us from our adversaries, and hast put them to shame that hate us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:8
segments: In God will we boast all the day, and we will praise thy name for ever. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 44:9
segments: ¶But thou hast cast off, and put us to confusion, and dost not go forth with our armies;

entries.title: Psalms 44:10
segments: Thou hast made us to turn back from the adversary, and they that hate us spoil for themselves;

entries.title: Psalms 44:11
segments: Thou hast given us over like sheep [appointed] for meat, and hast scattered us among the nations;

entries.title: Psalms 44:12
segments: Thou hast sold thy people for nought, and hast not increased [thy wealth] by their price;

entries.title: Psalms 44:13
segments: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a mockery and a derision for them that are round about us;

entries.title: Psalms 44:14
segments: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 44:15
segments: All the day my confusion is before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

entries.title: Psalms 44:16
segments: Because of the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and the avenger.

entries.title: Psalms 44:17
segments: ¶All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely against thy covenant:

entries.title: Psalms 44:18
segments: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy path;

entries.title: Psalms 44:19
segments: Though thou hast crushed us in the place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

entries.title: Psalms 44:20
segments: If we had forgotten the name of our God, and stretched out our hands to a strange *god,

entries.title: Psalms 44:21
segments: Would not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

entries.title: Psalms 44:22
segments: But for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are reckoned as sheep for slaughter.

entries.title: Psalms 44:23
segments: Awake, why sleepest thou, Lord? arise, cast [us] not off for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 44:24
segments: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, [and] forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

entries.title: Psalms 44:25
segments: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 44:26
segments: Rise up for our help, and redeem us for thy loving-kindness' sake.
